title: Practice 20: Where: над, под, за, перед, между

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Надругательство над ___ (душа), больше ничего!
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.
